name: sortable
title: Sortable
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: A headless drag-to-reorder system built on @dnd-kit. Supports whole-row drag or handle-only mode, custom drag overlays, vertical list and grid layouts, and a useSortableList hook for typed list mutations.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/sortable. Wrap your list with SortableRoot, mark each row with SortableItem, and optionally add SortableHandle for grip-only drag. Pass config={{ layout: 'grid' }} for grid layouts. Use useSortableList for typed list state.
